final: SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean as above_mean FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) p, (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating)) o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating
